Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez warned demonstrators that wearing Halloween masks or concealing faces would incur strict fines, following weeks of unrest that spurred over 1,300 arrests and drove French 10-year bond yields to 5%.

note: Police enforce localized Paris curfews and mobilize 70,000 officers amid mask warnings.

before.story: Melanie Lynskey Cast in 'Mushroom Murders' Series
before.summary: Emmy-nominated actor Melanie Lynskey has been cast as triple murderer Erin Patterson in the upcoming Paramount+ series 'Mushroom Murders: There’s More to Unearth.' This casting announcement arrives as the Victoria Court of Appeal prepares to deliver its final decision on Patterson's bid to overturn her triple murder conviction.

after.story: Erin Patterson Appeal Rejected in Mushroom Murders Case
after.summary: Victoria's Court of Appeal dismissed triple-murderer Erin Patterson's bid to overturn her convictions for killing three relatives using death cap mushroom-laced beef Wellingtons, increasing her sentence to make her ineligible for parole. Concurrently, Paramount+ cast Emmy-nominated actor Melanie Lynskey to portray Patterson in the upcoming dramatization series 'Mushroom Murders: There’s More to Unearth.'

note: Appeals court dismisses Erin Patterson's appeal and revokes parole eligibility for life.

before.story: South Africa Beats Australia 2-1 to Clinch Deciding Test Series
before.summary: South Africa defeated Australia 2-1 to clinch a deciding Test series victory after bowling out the visitors during their fourth-innings 288-run chase at Newlands. Anchored by centuries from Temba Bavuma, Ryan Rickelton, and Wiaan Mulder, alongside a career-best 6-16 spell from spinner Simon Harmer, the Proteas dethroned Australia to capture the top ranking in the World Test Championship standings.

after.story: South Africa Beats Australia 2-1 to Clinch Deciding Test Series
after.summary: South Africa defeated Australia 2-1 to win their deciding Test series at Newlands after bowling out the visitors during their fourth-innings 288-run chase, claiming the top spot in the World Test Championship standings. note: Proteas defeat Australia by 288-run margin chase to secure 2-1 series victory.

before.story: Binance Replenishes Stolen Funds After Record Hack
before.summary: Binance announced that approximately 90% of cryptocurrency assets stolen in a record $6.3 billion security breach attributed by blockchain firm TRM to North Korean 'TraderTraitor' operatives have been replenished. The restoration follows massive emergency deposit and trading freezes, alongside intensifying demands from CFTC Chairman Michael Selig and global exchanges for rigorous regulatory standards and infrastructure overhauls.

before.story: Chelsea Defeats Manchester United 2-0 as Martinez Sent Off
before.summary: Chelsea defeated Manchester United 2-0 at Stamford Bridge in west London to reclaim fourth place in the Premier League, sealed by goals from Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer. The defeat intensified managerial pressure on Michael Carrick after defender Lisandro Martínez received a straight red card in the second half.
